final: SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched_records FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.insurstat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, fraction_of_matched_records DESC LIMIT 10
